p: if thou wilt walk before me: If you walk in my fear, and withdraw yourself from the common manner of men, who follow their sensualities.
not keep my commandments and my: God declares that disobedience against him, is the cause of his displeasure, and so of all misery.
proverb and a byword among all: The world will make a mockery of you for the vile contempt and abusing of God's most liberal benefit.
sixscore: For his tribute toward the building.
talents of gold: The common talent was about 60 pound weight.
Millo: Millo was as the town house or place of assembly which was open above.
of store that Solomon had: Cities for his ammunition.
left of the Amorites: These were as bondmen and paid what was required, either labour or money.

five hundred and fifty: The overseers of Solomon's works were divided into three parts: the first contained 3300, the second 300, and the third 250 who were Israelites. Here are the two last parts, which make 550. See 2Ch 8:10.
four hundred and twenty talents: In 2Ch 8:18, 30 more are mentioned who seem to have been employed for their wages.
